Quarterly Refunding Statement of Deputy Assistant Secretary for Federal Finance Brian Smith

August 5, 2026

Bill Issuance

Given projections for receipts associated with the mid-September corporate and non-withheld tax date, Treasury expects to implement reductions to shorter-dated bill auction sizes during the month of September.

Cash Balance

Treasury is assuming a $950 billion cash balance at the end of September. However, Treasury estimates that the size of the Treasury General Account (TGA) could peak at $1.05 trillion (plus or minus $50 billion) in late October.
